text:
alex: Heads-up: we need to decide the rerank API's behavior when tenant requests > max_candidates. Currently we silently truncate. @maya any UX for console/alerts?
maya: Silent truncation has bitten prod. customers — surprising results and hard to debug.
sam: Agree. We should return a truncated_count field and a warning code so clients can instrument.
leo: +1. Also need model-affinity: prefer cheaper small-ranker for large candidate sets to control cost.
alex: Proposal: simple policy ruleset in the routing layer:
  - candidates > 200 -> route to "mini-ranker-v2" with sampling_policy = "budget-sample"
  - 50 < candidates <= 200 -> use "standard-ranker" with batching
  - <= 50 -> use "high-precision-ranker"
  Return policy metadata in response so clients know what happened.
jen: Console changes: show "routing reason", "candidate_count", "estimated_token_cost" per call. Admin toggle to opt into approximate fallbacks.
alex: Example response envelope we'd return (stable contract):
```json
{"scores": [...], "model": "mini-ranker-v2", "policy": "budget-sample", "truncated_count": 42, "sample_rate": 0.2}
```
maya: Telemetry needs: counters for rerank.requests, rerank.truncated, rerank.fallback.approximate, dimension by tenant and model. Latency histograms per model.
sam: Also want a histogram for candidate_count and sample_rate to tune thresholds. Add tag rerank.quality_alert=true when correlation delta exceeds threshold.
infra-bot: Plan: canary deploy policy change to 5% traffic for 24h. Monitor error_rate, latency_p50/p95, and quality_gates.
leo: Quota semantics: instead of 429 on soft overage, prefer implicit fallback to approximate ranking (if tenant allowed) and emit quota_warning event. Hard 429 only when burst protection or explicit limit reached.
maya: Billing: define score_unit: full_prec_candidate=1, sampled_candidate=0.25, cached_candidate=0.05. Show estimated units in console and in response header X-Estimated-Score-Units.
jen: UX: tenant settings: "allow_approximate_fallback": bool, "max_candidate_soft": int, "max_candidate_hard": int. Tooltip explains tradeoffs and rollback steps.
alex: Clients want normalized scores. Enforce that all models return normalized confidence in the envelope (0..1). If downstream model gives logits, runtime will normalize before sending.
sam: Edge-case: when combining models (hybrid fanout) we need provenance per-score: add optional scores_meta array with model tags (can be empty for stable contract).
leo: Action items: sam -> PR for telemetry counters and histogram buckets; alex -> PR to spec the response envelope and routing reasons; maya -> console mockups for policy panel; jen -> tenant settings and admin override; infra-bot -> schedule canary and add quality-gate triggers.
maya: Suggest adding an automated offline eval: compute Spearman rho between canonical and fallback topK; if rho < 0.8, block rollout.
sam: We'll add quality gates into deploy pipeline and emit rerank.quality_alert when failed.
jen: Timeline: aim for design + spec this week, implement next sprint, canary mid-sprint.
alex: I'll draft the API spec and include sample responses, migration notes, and a compatibility section for clients that rely on score normalization.
maya: Also add an audit log entry per-tenant when fallback kicks in (for CS + customers).
alex: Good call. Also add an admin console action to force canonical model per-tenant for debugging.
maya: OK thanks team — filing follow-ups in tickets now.
